unresolved_intent_refusal.action_before_append: recover the blocking pull request through authenticated readback before appending another merge attempt on this base branch
unresolved_intent_refusal.action_before_preflight: recover the blocking pull request through authenticated readback before starting another merge attempt on this base branch

attempt_recovery.action: recover the blocking pull request through authenticated readback under its admitted mission before continuing on this base branch

local_single_writer_sandbox.sandbox_requirement: the trusted host must exclude every other Forgejo writer for the whole admission, verification, merge, and readback interval

writer_admission.supervisor_capability_protocol: single bounded inherited AF_UNIX SOCK_SEQPACKET consumed before credential read and rechecked immediately before merge POST
